segments.description: Designs, sources and sells outdoor lifestyle products and shooting sports accessories under owned brands for rugged outdoor enthusiasts, hunters, anglers and shooters.
segments.evidence: We have evaluated our operations under ASC 280-10-50-1 – Segment Reporting and have concluded that we are operating as one segment based on several key factors, including the reporting and review process used by the chief operating decision maker, or CODM, who reviews only consolidated financial information and makes decisions to allocate resources based on those financial statements.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and retailers pay the company for outdoor lifestyle products and shooting sports accessories bought through e-commerce and traditional distribution channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary target customers are consumers who participate in outdoor and recreational activities and maintain active lifestyles.
